blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A new resolution which reiterates the need for a congressional investigation on the large-scale dredging operations in Zambales has been filed by Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima, saying that the ecosystem damage continues if this issue remains unchecked. In a statement, de Lima said she filed House Resolution No. 1601 calling on the House of Representatives to conduct an inquiry on the dredging operations in Zambales’ rivers and coastal waters, and the alleged presence of Chinese vessels in the area.
